tasks.title: Author the shared build-type interview guide
tasks.description: Create .agent/plan-interview.md containing the full interview script: Phase A universal triage (four one-at-a-time questions ending in a build-type classifier), Phase B deep-dive tracks for Game / CLI tool / App / Library plus a generic fallback, and the synthesis + confirm-back section that maps answers onto requirements.json fields (summary, goals, features, constraints) and a first-draft task-plan.json. Written agent-agnostically so Claude Code and Codex can both run it.
acceptance_criteria: .agent/plan-interview.md exists with Phase A, Phase B (4 tracks + generic fallback), and synthesis/confirm-back sections.
Each Phase B track lists concrete questions and names the requirements.json field(s) it feeds.
The guide instructs the agent to confirm proposed requirements.json and task-plan.json with the operator before writing, and to stop for human approval before plan seed.

tasks.title: Wire the interview into the agent operator surfaces
tasks.description: Update .claude/commands/plan.md step 2 to direct the agent to conduct the interview in .agent/plan-interview.md before writing artifacts; update the /plan row and slash-command section in AGENTS.md to reference the guide so Codex operators follow it. No behavior change to the CLI.
acceptance_criteria: .claude/commands/plan.md step 2 references .agent/plan-interview.md as the interview to run.
AGENTS.md points operators at the interview guide from the /plan documentation.

tasks.title: Update HOWTO.md for human operators
tasks.description: Update HOWTO.md so human operators know /plan now runs a build-type interview: describe the two-phase flow, what it produces, and the confirm-back gates, pointing at .agent/plan-interview.md for the full script.
acceptance_criteria: HOWTO.md describes the interview behavior for human operators and points at the interview guide.

tasks.title: Add a drift guard (doctor check + test)
tasks.description: Add a doctor check that .agent/plan-interview.md exists and is referenced from the operator surfaces, and a test in tests/appbuilder.test.js asserting the guide's presence and that the /plan command references it. Written test-first.
acceptance_criteria: doctor reports an ok line when the interview guide exists and is referenced, and a fail line when it is missing or unreferenced.
A test asserts the guide exists and that .claude/commands/plan.md references it.
